title: Boutique Showroom
caption: A shop to walk through, lit by its window and its spots
blurb: A small boutique with six real products on plinths and shelves: click one and the camera walks over for a close look. The only lights are the sun through the shop window and the shop’s own lamps, so the warm bounce off the terrazzo, the soft shadow under each product and the reflections in the floor are traced as you watch, by day and in the evening.
